events.title: Kraft Heinz Q1 Earnings Beat Estimates Despite Organic Sales Dip
events.body: KHC beats first-quarter estimates on revenues and EPS, but organic sales slip as volume declines and cost pressures weigh on operating income.

events.title: Utz Brands (UTZ) Q1 Earnings and Revenues Surpass Estimates
events.body: Utz Brands (UTZ) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of +9.73% and +0.11%, respectively, for the quarter ended March 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?

events.title: Medifast Q1 Loss Narrower Than Expected, Revenues Decline Y/Y
events.body: MED beats first-quarter estimates despite steep revenue declines, while stronger coach productivity and a new product launch support recovery hopes.

events.title: Energizer Q2 Earnings Top Estimates on Tariff Refund Benefit
events.body: ENR Q2 earnings beat on tariff refund gains and margin expansion, even as a y/y sales decline and volume pressures tied to timing and mix weigh on the results.
